sample_unit: participants (pregnant women) in the primary evaluation set
models_evaluated: AI gestational age estimation model for blind sweep ultrasonography (fine-tuned)

links.outcome: Gestational age MAE reported separately by site (Chicago vs Nairobi) and probe
links.effect: Adapted model MAE 4.1 days (95% CI 3.5-4.7) in Chicago and 4.3 days (95% CI 3.8-4.8) in Nairobi; overall noninferior to clinical standard (4.2 vs 4.5 days).
links.quote: The adapted model achieved an MAE of 4.1 days (95% CI, 3.5-4.7) in Chicago and 4.3 days (95% CI, 3.8-4.8 days) in Nairobi.

unlisted_practices: Protocolized blind sweep ultrasonography acquisition by novice operators with AI interpretation

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic validation of an AI model estimating gestational age from blind ultrasound sweeps by novice operators across two international clinical settings, evaluating diagnostic accuracy rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
